name: DEAD OF THE BRAIN ~Shiryou no Sakebi~
original_name: DEAD OF THE BRAIN ～死霊の叫び～
source:
First part of the Nightmare Collection with [url=https://vndb.org/v8961]Marine Philt[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/v6037]Dead of the Brain 2[/url].

A survival horror adventure game. You take the role of a young man named Kohl who must survive a nightmarish zombie infestation thanks in no small part to his old friend Doctor Cooger. When facing the zombie enemies a timer will come up and you will have a limited amount of time to figure out how to get rid of them before they get you.

[From [url=http://www.gamespot.com/users/Panzer_Zwei/blog?page=2]Gamespot[/url]]
translation:
“Nightmare Collection”系列的第一部作品，同系列还包括[url=https://vndb.org/v8961]《Marine Philt》[/url]和[url=https://vndb.org/v6037]《Dead of the Brain 2》[/url]。

这是一款生存恐怖冒险游戏。玩家将扮演名叫Kohl的年轻男子，在老友Cooger博士的大力帮助下，设法从噩梦般的僵尸灾难中幸存。遭遇僵尸敌人时，画面上会出现计时器；你必须在有限时间内找出消灭它们的方法，否则就会成为它们的猎物。

[摘自[url=http://www.gamespot.com/users/Panzer_Zwei/blog?page=2]Gamespot[/url]]
